technology.value: 20-kiloton liquid-scintillator sphere viewed by large- and small-diameter photomultiplier tubes, immersed in a water-Cherenkov veto pool with an overhead Top Tracker
technology.quote: The central detector contains 20,000 tons liquid scintillator with an acrylic sphere of 35 m in diameter. ... The veto system ... consists of a Water Cherenkov detector and a Top Tracker system.

placements.quote: Detector installation started in 2021 and completed in December 2024
placements.note: Start year taken from a search-summarised IHEP report, not verbatim text in a fetched page.

intervals.label: installation
intervals.quote: Detector installation started in 2021 and completed in December 2024
intervals.note: Start year taken from a search-summarised IHEP report, not verbatim text seen in a fetched page; recorded approximate accordingly.

intervals.label: filling with ultrapure water and liquid scintillator
intervals.quote: During the first two months, the inner and outer spaces of the acrylic sphere will be filled with ultrapure water. Over the following six months, the ultrapure water inside the acrylic sphere will be replaced with liquid scintillator.

intervals.label: physics data taking
intervals.quote: JUNO began physics data taking on August 26, 2025

target_mass.quote: The central detector contains 20,000 tons liquid scintillator with an acrylic sphere of 35 m in diameter.

pmt_count.quote: The facility is equipped with 20,000 20-inch photomultiplier tubes and 25,000 3-inch photomultiplier tubes
pmt_count.note: A separate array of ~25,000 (25,600 per the 2021 design paper) 3-inch PMTs forms a complementary double-calorimeter system; recorded in `subsystems` rather than as a second `pmt_count` (not an Appendix A key for a second array).

energy_resolution.note: This is the pre-operation design target. The first measured performance (Chin. Phys. C 50, 043001 (2026)) reports 3.4% at 0.511 MeV -- see result:juno-initial-performance-2026.

description.value: A complementary array of roughly 25,000 3-inch photomultiplier tubes providing an independent, non-saturating energy measurement alongside the 20-inch PMT array
description.quote: 20,000 20-inch photomultiplier tubes and 25,000 3-inch photomultiplier tubes that work together to detect flashes of light

subsystems.name: Water Cherenkov veto and Top Tracker

description.value: A water-Cherenkov detector plus an overhead Top Tracker system used for muon detection and cosmogenic-background rejection
description.quote: The veto system is used for muon detection, muon induced background study and reduction. It consists of a Water Cherenkov detector and a Top Tracker system.

summary.plain: A 20,000-tonne sphere of clear liquid, watched by 20,000 large light sensors and 25,000 smaller ones, sitting inside a pool of water that screens out stray particles.
summary.technical: 20 kt liquid-scintillator central detector in a 35 m acrylic sphere, read out by 20,000 20-inch and ~25,000 3-inch PMTs, immersed in a water-Cherenkov veto pool with an overhead Top Tracker; design energy resolution 3.02%/√E (MeV).
